justification: Missing bounds checking on netlink attribute index and data validation before parsing
analysis: The function reads a u8 value from netlink attributes using nla_get_u8() on index IPSET_ATTR_PROTOCOL. The attacker can influence the netlink attribute data that gets parsed and stored in tb[] array. There are no bounds checks performed on the tb[] array index or the attribute data itself before calling nla_get_u8().
